preamble_injection_reason: U+220E END OF PROOF has no glyph in the default Latin Modern font under the XeTeX-family engine pandoc drives for tectonic. Without this mapping the 3 QED marks present in the canonical source were silently dropped from the render. The canonical source bytes are unchanged; only the render preamble is affected.

authority.note: Building a PDF changes no scientific authority; this is a review render of the frozen bounded manuscript.

workflow_cut.note: Header displays the 12-character prefix; the full digest is recorded here. The 64-character form set verbatim in the header ran 73.1pt off page 1.
